questions.prompt: How much solar power capacity (photovoltaic and concentrated solar) was installed worldwide at the end of 2025, in gigawatts, according to IRENA?
questions.insight: Solar is the largest renewable source, and 2025 saw record additions of 511 GW, about 27% growth in a single year.

questions.prompt: What share of the world's e-waste generated in 2022 was documented as formally collected and recycled in an environmentally sound manner, according to the UN Global E-waste Monitor 2024?
questions.insight: Since 2010, e-waste generation has grown almost five times faster than documented formal collection and recycling.

questions.prompt: How many million science and engineering (S&E) journal articles were published worldwide in 2022, according to the US National Science Foundation (Scopus data)?
questions.insight: China and India together accounted for more than half of the growth in global output between 2010 and 2022.

questions.prompt: In constant 2021 US dollars, what is the CSIS Aerospace Security Project's estimate of the cost per kilogram of payload to low Earth orbit for a SpaceX Falcon 9 as first flown in 2010 (dedicated launch, based on unit flyaway cost)?

source.name: CSIS Aerospace Security Project (via Our World in Data)

questions.insight: On the same basis, the Space Shuttle cost about $65,400 per kilogram to low Earth orbit.

questions.prompt: According to WHO's global tobacco trends report, how many people worldwide used tobacco in 2024?
questions.insight: The number of tobacco users has dropped from 1.38 billion in 2000.
